title: A Clause In Front
label: ch:ml-participle
canDo: I can say which one I mean by putting a whole clause in front of the noun, the way Malayalam does it.

payoff.summary: From cold: the describing form in both tenses, the position it stands in, and the joining word English needs and Malayalam does not have.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three. No new vocabulary: every verb and noun in it is taught, and the describing form is the taught present or past with one vowel sign removed.
